scripts.actions_last_object.msg_1: The strange symbol in the wall in the back glows violently.
scripts.actions_last_object.msg_2: The cult object just lies there quietly. The dangerous area around it has been all but dissolved.
scripts.actions_last_object.msg_3: As you reach out to touch the cult object, a surge of energy burst from the skull. You banished its power.
scripts.actions_crate.msg_1: Perfect! You took a wonderful loupe from this crate.
scripts.actions_crate.msg_3: This crate belongs to Angelo. You should talk to him before taking something out.
scripts.movements_task_teleport.msg_1: The power of these souls is now within you. You cannot absorb any more souls.
scripts.actions_analyser.msg_1: Well done! The water is analyzed.
scripts.actions_misguided.msg_1: You paralyse the bully and the amulet reveals the true face of the creature behind the possession of this misguided creature.
scripts.movements_ice_death.msg_1: You were killed by something evil and others.
scripts.movements_ice_death.msg_2: You are still blessed with Wisdom of Solitude, Spark of the Phoenix, Fire of the Suns, Spiritual Shielding, Embrace of Tibia, Heart of the Mountain, Blood of the Mountain, and Twist of Fate.
scripts.movements_ice_death.msg_3: You lost 0 experience and 0.00% of all of your skills.
scripts.movements_ice_death.msg_4: You did not lose any items.
scripts.movements_begin_task.msg_1: The amulet burns your skin. It hungers for energy right now, gather a large amount of energy as fast as possible to charge it.
scripts.movements_energy_fence.msg_1: With you being the vessel binding the power of whitered souls, you step through the magic barrier.
scripts.movements_energy_fence.msg_2: The combined powers of decaying souls roaming these halls may help breach this barrier, it needs but a vessel to bind them.
scripts.movements_energy_fence.msg_3: With you being the vessel binding the power of whitered souls, you step through the magic barrier.
scripts.movements_energy_fence.msg_4: The combined powers of decaying souls roaming these halls may help breach this barrier, it needs but a vessel to bind them.
scripts.movements_energy_fence.msg_5: As you cross the threshold in to the inner sanctuary of the cult of the Misguided, you feel an eerie presence all around you.
